_comment: PEMF -- happenings at sea and in harbour.
Plain content events: triggers and effects as documented in
docs/EVENT_AUTHORING.md. Every one has a cooldown so none of them nags.
Delete this file to turn them all off.

events.body: The lookout sings out: wreckage on the swell, a spar and a tangle of rigging, and lashed to it a sea chest riding low in the water.

options.text: Heave to and haul it aboard.
options.outcome: It takes four men and a deal of swearing, but the chest comes over the rail. Inside, wrapped in oilcloth, are coins enough to make the morning worthwhile.

options.text: Leave it. Someone drowned for that chest.
options.outcome: You hold your course. Some of the older hands nod; there are things a sailor does not take from the sea.

events.body: Fever has come aboard. Three men are down with it in the forecastle and the surgeon, such as he is, says it will spread before it burns out.

options.text: Make for the nearest port and put the sick ashore.
options.outcome: Two of them are carried down the gangway and do not come back. The rest of your crew of {crew} sleep easier for it.

options.text: Keep them aboard and pray it passes.
options.outcome: It does not pass quickly. By the time the fever breaks, five hammocks are empty and the men look at each other sidelong.

events.body: A thread of smoke from a sandbar no bigger than a longboat. As you close, a ragged figure staggers to the water's edge waving a shirt on a stick.

options.outcome: He has been there five weeks, he says, and he will sign any articles you care to name. He can hand, reef and steer, which is more than some.

options.text: Sail on. Castaways are marooned for a reason.
options.outcome: The smoke dwindles astern. Nobody mentions it, which is how you know they are all thinking about it.

events.body: As {port} comes abeam, the bosun reports that a handful of men have been whispering about the taverns ashore and the wages honest ships pay.

options.text: Promise them a share of the next prize.
options.outcome: Coin changes hands and the whispering stops. For now, the crew of {crew} is yours.

options.text: Double the watch and let them try.
options.outcome: Three of them go over the side in the dark and swim for {port}. You are well rid of them, you tell yourself.

events.body: A fair wind and a bone in her teeth! The men are singing at the capstan.
The purser shows you the strongbox. There is more dust in it than gold, and the men will want paying before long.

options.text: Tell them the next prize is all theirs.
options.outcome: They cheer, as men do when promised the moon. Best find them a prize.

options.text: Say nothing and hope they don't ask.
options.outcome: They ask. Of course they ask.

events.body: Dolphins under the bow! The men call it a good omen.
{months} months at sea. The men are talking about home, and about division of the plunder.
